analysis_matrix.timestamp_basis: device sample times only after G qualification; otherwise report supported long-window relative power, not per-inference energy

comparison_execution_note: All E arms/formats remain enumerated. This is a conditional full matrix, not a command to run unsupported or unqualified variants; only exact H plus live-camera gates may shortlist physical arms. Each reported comparison still requires ten started paired blocks.

paired_physical_block_rule.nested_repeats: repeat within each block only after meter bandwidth and settling are qualified
paired_physical_block_rule.randomization: derive a per-comparison/per-root order seed from SHA-256(comparison_id|root_seed|block_index); persist before capture
paired_physical_block_rule.training_roots_per_comparison: all ten matched training roots; pair same root, input, and condition within block
paired_physical_block_rule.unsupported_arm_handling: retain every variant row and exact failure/probe status; do not enter it in a powered comparison unless exact H and live camera gates pass
